The issuer demonstrates moderate financial strength with an EBIT margin of ~7.3%, an interest coverage capacity backed by stable net income ($153M), and a healthy balance sheet profile characterized by a moderate debt-to-equity posture (Total Liabilities / Equity of ~1.49x) and adequate short-term liquidity (Current Ratio of 1.50x). However, the absolute profitability margins and leverage levels do not warrant a high investment-grade rating, placing the company solidly in the mid-investment-grade tier.

DECISION: BBB
